pdf.noWorkspace: PDFs need the workspace, which this browser can't provide.
pdf.page.label: Page {n}
pdf.unanchored: Text not found on the page.
pdf.notesUnreadable: the highlights block in {name} can't be read. Fix or remove it to highlight again.
pdf.ocr.scanned: This page is a scanned image.
pdf.ocr.none: This PDF has no scanned pages left to recognise.
pdf.zotero.confirm: Send {n} highlights to Zotero? They are saved on zotero.org as annotations on “{title}”, with the key kept in this device's secret store. This is the only thing Lumen writes to Zotero.
pdf.zotero.partial: {n} highlights sent to Zotero; it refused {failed}.
pdf.zotero.nothing: Every highlight is already in Zotero.
pdf.zotero.noLibrary: Sync your Zotero library from zotero.org first (Citations: sync the Zotero library from zotero.org).
pdf.zotero.noAttachment: This PDF isn't a PDF attachment in your synced Zotero library. Add “zotero-attachment: KEY” to the front matter of {note}.
pdf.zotero.noWrite: Your Zotero key can't write. On zotero.org → Settings → Security → Applications, edit the key and allow write access.
